description: This PHP class defines the EmailSubscriber entity, which maps to the 'ohrm_email_subscriber' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, email, and a relation to an EmailNotification entity, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailSubscriber
classes.description: Entity class representing an email subscriber with properties for id, name, email, and a relation to an EmailNotification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email subscriber.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email subscriber.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the subscriber.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the subscriber.
